policy.name: precision_first_v1
policy.grid_precedence: official_gridmap; vendor is contextual evidence only
policy.missing_values: null; no imputation or positive evidence from absence
policy.area: registry parcel area is an explicit usable-area proxy unless contradicted
policy.owner_status: latest dated explicit evidence; same-date conflicts remain unknown
policy.sentiment: latest per actor and scope; opposition wins across actors; conditional stays unknown
policy.duplicates: same region/parcel/type, identical sources, within 0.1 km; lowest ID is canonical
policy.eligibility: exclude protected sites and current owner refusal; hold unknown critical inputs or conflicts
policy.unknown_sentiment: retain for scoring with null sentiment; score must expose incompleteness
policy.reference_size: no additional 2 MW minimum or new flood/opposition kill rules
